title: unified-rollouts-enhance-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-observability-and-safety-guards
author: Aisha Patel
body: Summary: Improve observability and safety guards for unified rollouts' automated rollback workflows. This PR adds additional telemetry points (per-rollout and per-stage metrics), tighter quorum logic for quarantine/probing stages, and a stabilization window to reduce flapping re-rollbacks. Motivation: recent incidents showed noisy metrics and rapid auto-rollbacks during transient infra noise. We need clearer signals and more robust quorum rules so that automatic rollbacks are reliable and actionable. Changes: 1) Add rollout-level metrics: rollout_start, rollout_stage_change, rollback_initiated (with reason tag), rollback_decision_score, metric_quorum_status. 2) Instrument e2e traces for canary, A/B, and shadow stages to tie requests to rollout traces for easier debugging. 3) Introduce 'stabilization_window_ms' config per-stage that delays autorestore/autoroll decisions until the window elapses. 4) Tighten quarantine quorum: require >=3 distinct metric sources or >=80% of data points within window before a quarantine triggers. 5) Add an observability dashboard manifest and alert rules for rollback rate, rollback decision score regression, and prolonged quarantine. 6) Add unit and integration tests for quorum and stabilization behavior. How tested: unit tests added for quorum logic, integration tests added to perf-canary job to simulate noisy metric bursts, manual canary in staging with a small A/B experiment, and e2e tracing validated with Zipkin traces. Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and tags - [x] Add stabilization window config and default - [x] Implement stronger quorum logic - [x] Add dashboards and alerts - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Update docs and rollout examples - [x] Run staging canary and validate traces Known limitations: this PR increases telemetry cardinality; we've added safeguards (sampling and aggregation) to cap costs. Follow-ups: add sampling knobs to rollout-level traces and propagate tenant IDs for aggregated billing. Related: ENG-5432 (automatic rollback robustness), ENG-5460 (observability for rollouts).

diff_snippets:
--- a/redwood/unified_rollouts/autorollback_engine.py
+++ b/redwood/unified_rollouts/autorollback_engine.py
@@ -120,6 +120,28 @@
-    if failing_ratio > threshold:
-        trigger_rollback()
+    # respect stabilization window before finalizing auto-rollback decision
+    if time_since_stage_start < config.stabilization_window_ms:
+        log.debug('stabilization window active, deferring decision')
+        return Decision.DEFER
+    if not quorum.evaluate(sources, config.quorum_requirements):
+        log.info('quorum not satisfied, entering quarantine')
+        enter_quarantine()
+        return Decision.QUARANTINE
+    if failing_ratio > threshold:
+        trigger_rollback(reason='metric_threshold')
--- a/redwood/unified_rollouts/quorum.py
+++ b/redwood/unified_rollouts/quorum.py
@@ -1,6 +1,38 @@
+def evaluate(sources, requirements):
+    \"\"\"Return True when quorum is satisfied: at least N distinct sources and at least P percent agreement.\"\"\"
+    distinct = {s.source_id for s in sources}
+    if len(distinct) < requirements.min_sources:
+        return False
+    agree_percent = compute_agreement(sources, requirements.window_ms)
+    return agree_percent >= requirements.required_percent
review_comments: Marco Hernandez: Nice work — I like the stabilization window. Question: will this delay cause slower recovery for true regressions? Can we make the window adaptive?
Aisha Patel: Good point. We made the window per-stage and conservative by default (30s). Follow-up will add adaptive logic based on historical noise; for now ops can override per-rollout.
Dana Li: Quorum algorithm looks sensible; please add a unit test for the edge case when sources report with significant clock skew.
Aisha Patel: Added tests simulating clock skew and included source timestamp normalization logic in quorum.evaluate().
Owen Brooks: Integration tests flaked once on CI (integration-tests), reran and passed. Approving with one nit: doc example still references old config name 'quarantine_threshold'.
Aisha Patel: Fixed docs and pushed follow-up commit to rename the config key to 'quarantine_requirements'. Thanks!
merge_outcome: merged via squash - commit message: 'unified rollouts: observability + safety guards for autorollback'
release_notes: Improve automatic rollback reliability: stabilization window and quorum enforcement
Add rollout-level metrics and traces: rollback_decision_score, rollback_initiated, rollout_stage_change
New alerts and dashboards for rollback rate and prolonged quarantine
notes_for_oncall: If a rollback loop is reported, check 'rollback_decision_score' and 'quarantine_status' on the rollout dashboard. If quarantine triggers too aggressively, you can increase min_sources or stabilization_window_ms for the rollout. If telemetry costs spike, disable rollout-level traces sampling via observability config.
changelog_short: observability + safety guards for autorollback (stabilization window and quorum enforcement)
